title: HOPE GARDENS HIDEAWAY! 1 MILE FROM DOWNTOWN
description:
Enjoy this warm and cozy home exactly 1 mile from Downtown Nashville. You will be within walking distance of stores, restaurants, music venues, parks and the
Nashville Farmers Market. This home also has a fully functional kitchen if you feel like staying in for the night. Grab a cup of coffee or a cocktail and relax on the backyard deck. Make yourself feel completely at home while staying in Music City!

The space
You will have access to the entire house - 2 floors, fenced in backyard, and 2 off-street parking spots. All of the beds and furniture in the house are brand new. There is 1 queen bed, 4 full beds, 1 couch, & 1 fold out bed. All beds will have memory foam & gel pillows. Fresh towels & linens will be provided for all guests. A stocked Keurig coffee maker will also be available to guests. There is a deck off the kitchen and back of the house. There is high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the house and a full-size washer & dryer next to the kitchen.
